commit.message:
http: attach a caller context to async client requests (#49113)

Commit Message: http: attach a caller context to async client requests

Add `AsyncClient::RequestContext`, set with
`RequestOptions::setContext()` as a `shared_ptr`. The request holds it
until it is destroyed and returns it from `Request::context()`, so
shared callbacks can get their per-request data back.

Use it for the mirror policy stats, which allocated callbacks per mirror
that deleted themselves from `onBeforeFinalizeUpstreamSpan()`.

Additional Description:
Follow-up to #48470, resolving the TODO on `ShadowRequestCallbacks`. As
@botengyao pointed out, the self-deletion relied on
`onBeforeFinalizeUpstreamSpan()` being called exactly once per request,
so a change there could leak the object. The context approach was
suggested by @wbpcode and keeps the callbacks' lifetime unchanged.

The shadow writer now uses its shared callbacks for all mirrors. For a
policy with `stat_prefix`, it sets a `ShadowRequestContext` that records
the outcome in `onSuccess()`/`onFailure()` and counts `rq_cancelled`
when destroyed without one. When `send()`/`startRequest()` returns
`nullptr`, a failure is recorded unless the callbacks already ran
inline. Policies without `stat_prefix` allocate nothing.

Risk Level: Low. New optional field; existing callers are unchanged.
Testing: New `async_client_impl_test` cases (context reachable from the
callbacks and released with the request on success, reset, cancel,
immediate and creation failure); updated `shadow_writer_impl_test`;
`router_test` and `shadow_policy_integration_test` pass.
Docs Changes: N/A
Release Notes: N/A
Platform Specific Features: N/A

---------

Signed-off-by: William Dauchy <william.dauchy@datadoghq.com>
